name: Saint Lucia (colony, 1939–1967)
description: A British Blue Ensign with the Union Flag in the canton and the colonial arms of Saint Lucia of 1939, a black shield with two Tudor roses and two fleurs-de-lis around a bamboo cross, in the fly.
history: Blue Ensign defaced with the arms granted to the colony of Saint Lucia in August 1939, whose roses and fleurs-de-lis recall the island's English and French past. It was replaced on 1 March 1967, when Saint Lucia became an Associated State, by the present flag designed by Dunstan St Omer.
